about_short_description.short_description: Terra is a healthcare infrastructure for apps to connect to wearables and sensors

product.name: Terra API
product.description: An API that standardizes and delivers health and fitness data from multiple wearable devices and sensors to applications.

product.name: Streaming API
product.description: Enables real-time streaming of health data from wearables to applications via BLE and ANT+ connections.

product.name: Team Sports API
product.description: Consolidates performance data from various sports measurement devices into a single integration for coaching and analysis.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: Customizable AI agents that analyze real-time wearable data to provide insights and perform actions like a personal coach.

product.name: Health Scores
product.description: Simplifies complex health data into single-value metrics like Sleep Score and Immune Index, delivered via API.

product.name: Health Rewards
product.description: A configurable system to reward users for healthy behaviors by assigning points for activities like steps, sleep, and milestones.
